cua-driver.description: Control the X11 desktop: take screenshots, inspect windows, and send mouse and keyboard actions.

playwright.description: Automate web pages in the container's shared Chromium browser.
args: p=$(basename "$(readlink "$CHROMIUM_USER_DATA_DIR/SingletonLock" 2>/dev/null)" | awk -F- '{print $NF}'); [ -n "$p" ] && [ -d "/proc/$p" ] || npx -y @playwright/cli open -s=shared --profile "$CHROMIUM_USER_DATA_DIR" --headed >/dev/null 2>&1; exec npx -y @playwright/mcp --endpoint shared
